observation.diagnostic_semantics: first cal_energy sample after 100 magnetic updates from retained restart; diagnostic-only block cap
observation.limitation: One 100-step diagnostic block only. This tests native source/attained accounting near the retained state; it is not a relaxation, convergence, or production endpoint.

cut_statistics_order: minimum signed integral over 32 toroidal cuts
mean signed integral over 32 toroidal cuts
maximum signed integral over 32 toroidal cuts
field_definitions.source_current_A: sum(current_scale_A*jphin) over unique owned derivative-interior cells satisfying ss<jcuts; jphin is the imposed parallel-source toroidal component formed by cal_netj from the total Bphi and normalized profile
field_definitions.attained_same_mask_A: sum(current_scale_A*jphi1) over the identical ss<jcuts cells; jphi1 is the toroidal component of curl(response field) computed by cal_j before cal_netj, not total or parallel current
field_definitions.attained_positive_pressure_A: sum(current_scale_A*jphi1) over p1b>0, exactly the support and quantity used by native history current
field_definitions.source_mask_active_cell_count: sum of unique interior source-mask cells across every toroidal cut (not a per-cut count)
field_definitions.source_mask_ss_and_Bphi_extrema: global extrema on ss<jcuts; ss is the step-start traced flux label and Bphi is normalized by B0
field_definitions.source_cancellation: cut0 sum(abs(cellwise source current)) and signed_source/absolute_source
field_definitions.step_start_paxis: axis pressure traced before the step-B substep loop, in mu0*Pa/B0^2; not retraced at diagnostic time
field_definitions.mpi_max_seconds: maximum rank elapsed wall time around cal_volume, source formation, source halo exchange and its barrier; excludes subsequent diagnostic reductions/output

observation.interpretation: The imposed source is supported and normalized as intended, while curl(response) is much smaller at this one mature-state sample. This does not by itself prove a drive implementation defect: the measured attained toroidal response includes perpendicular-current effects and may reflect relaxation/Faraday/resistive timescales. A controlled next measurement should resolve rate-of-change and Ohm/Faraday contributions before another eta variation.

provenance.warning: The shortened 100-step block matches the first 100 magnetic updates of the retained settings. Its endpoint is not cadence-identical beyond that block and must not be reused as production state without deliberation.

reproduction_limit: Hash-identified raw restart and prepared native inputs are not yet in a downloadable public dataset. This record is evidence of the bounded run, not an independently reproduced equilibrium.

observation.diagnostic_semantics: instantaneous post-RKG magnetic current-rate RHS at the existing cal_energy sample after cal_j, integrated on the frozen ss<jcuts source mask
cut_statistics_order: minimum signed integral over 32 toroidal cuts
mean signed integral over 32 toroidal cuts
maximum signed integral over 32 toroidal cuts

field_definitions.state: new non-mutating Faraday evaluation from the post-RKG current state; no last-RK-stage increment is reinterpreted as an instantaneous RHS
field_definitions.terms: each term and the independently evaluated total use the production Faraday curl, divergence and magnetic boundary stencils
field_definitions.current_rate: the production fourth-order toroidal curl is applied to each magnetic increment, integrated with rmaj0*b0*dr*dz/mu0, and divided by dt_b
field_definitions.mask: the same ss<jcuts cells are used for every term and remain unchanged throughout the diagnostic

observation.interpretation: At this sample the imposed term drives toroidal response current in the requested negative direction, while resistive-response and ideal terms oppose it; the net mean rate remains negative. This supports active relaxation and current redistribution rather than absent imposed support at this state.
observation.limitation: This is one instantaneous frozen-mask RHS sample. It does not establish a constant long-time relaxation rate, physical-second timescale, convergence, or a production endpoint.
